app_fee.value: Graduate application fee is $50 per primary application, reinstated for applications from August 1, 2026.
app_fee.quote: Effective August 1, 2026, our $50 graduate application fee will be reinstated

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate School does not grant individual fee waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: The Graduate School does not grant individual student requests for application fee

gre_general.value: The Graduate School sets no general GRE rule; each program states its own (see program records).

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum is 4.0 on the new scale for tests taken after January 21, 2026 (80 for earlier tests).
toefl_min.quote: Minimum score of 4.0 (for tests taken after January 21, 2026)

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic minimum is an overall 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS International Academic Course Type 2 | Minimum score of 6.5

english_waiver.value: Indian degrees are not exempt; the English-official-country list does not include India, and language of instruction alone is not accepted, so a test is required.
english_waiver.quote: We do not waive the requirement based solely on language of instruction

also.quote: If you earned a degree where the language of instruction was English in a country where English is not an official language, then you will be required to submit scores

notes: Most PhD programs use the general Graduate School application. Separate systems: Moore School of Business, Arnold School of Public Health (SOPHAS; Biostatistics PhD final deadline February 15), College of Nursing. No PhD in astronomy, materials science or data science found; neuroscience is a concentration in the Biomedical Science PhD. Not mapped: Pharmaceutical Sciences, Nuclear Engineering, Environmental Health Sciences, Epidemiology, Informatics (health informatics) PhDs.
